comments.headline: Use designation ambiguity and lot structure conflict
comments.summary: Project is labeled 'Valley View Townhomes' (39 units) but documentation inconsistently identifies units as townhomes, multifamily residential, and condominium. Units are grouped in multi-unit buildings (4-, 5-, 6-plexes) on a single master lot, not on separate townhouse lots. Master Comment Report (Sept 2025) requested use clarification; remains unresolved. Must clearly designate use and ensure all code compliance.
comments.attn: Master Comment Report SP3 (dated Sept 2025) flagged use designation ambiguity for clarification. This must be explicitly resolved in resubmittal. Recommend applicant choose single use designation and revise all documentation accordingly.

details.text: If multifamily residential use applies, units require proximity to public transit (within ½ mile walking distance) per LDC § 25-1-703(B)(4), or documented director's waiver approval. No transit route proximity evidence or waiver documentation provided in site plan or submittal materials.

runComments.comment: Project proposes 39 multifamily residential units. LDC § 25-1-703(B)(4) requires multifamily projects to be located within one-half mile walking distance of a public transit route, or documentation of an approved director's waiver. No evidence of transit route proximity or director's waiver documentation is provided in the site plan or submittal materials.

Multifamily residential use proposed (39 units). Requirement: project must be within one-half mile walking distance of a public transit route, or a director's waiver must be obtained. Neither transit proximity nor a director's waiver is documented on the site plan or in the submittal materials. Transit accessibility and any waiver determination must be verified or documented.

Site plan does not demonstrate compliance with multifamily residential transit proximity requirement. No documentation is provided confirming the project is within one-half mile walking distance of a public transit route, nor is documentation of an approved director's waiver provided. Transit route information is absent from the project location map and vicinity documentation.

details.text: If townhouse designation intended, each unit must be on separate townhouse lot per LDC § 25-2-775. Current design places 39 units in multi-unit buildings (4-plexes, 5-plexes, 6-plexes) grouped on single master lot (Lot 1, Mecey Subdivision). Alternatively, project must be redesignated as Multifamily Residential with all documentation updated.

runComments.comment: Project is identified as 'Valley View Townhomes' but site plan and application materials also designate the use as multifamily residential and condominium without explicit confirmation that each townhouse unit is located on a separate townhouse lot per LDC § 25-2-775. Master Comment Report SP3 (dated September 2025) requested clarification of proposed use, and this comment remains uncleared as of latest update. Confirmation of townhouse lot structure and compliance with § 25-2-775 lot requirements is not provided.

Project proposes 39 townhome units but units are not located on separate townhouse lots as required by LDC § 25-2-775. Instead, units are grouped in multi-unit buildings (4-plexes, 5-plexes, and 6-plexes) with no individual lot lines delineated. The entire development is on a single lot (Lot 1, Mecey Subdivision) and the site data table identifies the use as Multi-Family Residential. If townhouse designation is intended, each unit must be on a separate townhouse lot; alternatively, the project must be redesignated as Multifamily Residential and all documentation revised.

comments.headline: Condominium use standards not explicitly documented
comments.summary: Project identifies units as residential condominiums. If condominium is the final use designation, LDC § 25-2-776 establishes specific standards governing design, open space, and other condominium requirements. Compliance with these standards is not explicitly demonstrated in site plan data table or notes.
comments.attn: This comment is dependent on use designation clarification (Comment 1 above). Confirm whether condominium is the final use. If so, § 25-2-776 requirements (open space, architectural controls, common area provisions, unit lot design) must be documented on the site plan or in a separate compliance matrix.

details.text: Site plan identifies use as residential condominium but does not explicitly address LDC § 25-2-776 condominium use standards in site plan data table, notes, or compliance documentation. Requirements for open space, architectural design, and common area provisions must be documented.

runComments.comment: Project is identified as a residential condominium. LDC § 25-2-776 establishes standards for condominium use, including open space and other applicable requirements. Compliance with § 25-2-776 requirements is not explicitly demonstrated in the site plan data table or notes.

comments.headline: Article 10 Compatibility Standards analysis and documentation missing
comments.summary: Site is MF-2 zoned, adjacent to SF-3 parcel (0406100210) within 25 feet, triggering LDC Subchapter F (Article 10) Compatibility Standards per § 25-2-1051. Requirements include height limits (40 ft within 50 ft of SF-3 line, 30 ft within 25 ft), 25-foot compatibility buffer, screening, lighting, and noise restrictions. Neither substantive analysis nor compliance notes appear on site plan.
comments.attn: Verify actual building heights (Buildings 1-8) relative to SF-3 property line and applicability of step-up schedule per § 25-2-1063. If any building exceeds height limits in compatibility zone, massing/height reduction or design modification required.

details.text: No analysis demonstrating compliance with Article 10 height limits, compatibility buffer, screening, lighting, or noise restrictions. Specifically: 40-foot height limit within 50 feet of SF-3 property line; 30-foot limit within 25 feet; 25-foot compatibility buffer with screening per § 25-2-1063. No dimensional or locational data provided.

runComments.comment: Site is zoned MF-2 (less restrictive than MF-4) and located within 25 feet of an adjacent SF-3-zoned parcel, triggering Article 10 Compatibility Standards per LDC § 25-2-1051. Current Article 10 requirements (height limits, compatibility buffers, screening, lighting, and noise restrictions) are not demonstrated on the site plan. No analysis addressing the 40-foot height limit within 50 feet of the SF-3 property line, the 25-foot compatibility buffer along the shared property line, or other § 25-2-1063 requirements is provided.

details.text: Site plan contains no specific notes identifying which Article 10 provisions (LDC §§ 25-2-1051–1063) apply to this project. Current ordinance (Ord. 20240516-004, effective July 15, 2024) requires explicit compatibility notes on site plan specifying applicable height limits, buffer/setback standards, screening, lighting, and noise restrictions.

runComments.comment: No compatibility notes are included on the site plan specifying which LDC sections apply to this project. Current Article 10 ordinance (Ord. 20240516-004, effective July 15, 2024) requires compatibility notes reflecting current code provisions. Notes must address applicability of height limits, buffer and setback standards, screening, lighting, and noise restrictions per LDC §§ 25-2-1051–25-2-1063.

comments.headline: Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area requirements not documented
comments.summary: Site is located in Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area per LDC § 25-10-152. Site plan includes general compliance note ('all signs must comply with... Chapter 25-10') but does not specifically address § 25-10-152 nonconforming signs ordinance area standards. Area-specific signage compliance must be explicitly documented.
comments.attn: Add explicit note to site plan specifying: 'All signage shall comply with LDC § 25-10-152 Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area requirements.' Confirm final signage design (if any) complies with area-specific limitations.

details.text: Site plan includes general note that 'All signs must comply with requirements of the Land Development Code (Chapter 25-10)' but does not specifically address LDC § 25-10-152 Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area requirements. Area-specific standards for nonconforming signs areas must be explicitly documented.

runComments.comment: Site is located within a Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area per facts.md. While site plan includes a general note that 'All signs must comply with requirements of the Land Development Code (Chapter 25-10),' the site plan does not specifically address compliance with LDC § 25-10-152 Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area requirements. Area-specific signage standards must be explicitly documented.

Site is located in a Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area per LDC § 25-10-152. While the site plan includes a general sign compliance note stating all signs must comply with Chapter 25-10, specific compliance with the nonconforming signs ordinance requirements is not demonstrated. Site plan must include a note confirming that all signage complies with LDC § 25-10-152 requirements for nonconforming signs ordinance areas.
